robust_cell: sharpe_IS > 0 and sharpe_VAL > 0 and PF_IS > 1 and PF_VAL > 1
contiguity: orthogonal four-neighbor adjacency in the original locked grid
largest_robust_region: largest orthogonally connected component of robust cells
medoid: cell in the largest robust component minimizing total Manhattan grid distance; ties use higher consensus_score then combination_id
entire_is_zone_collapsed: at least one IS-positive cell exists and zero robust cells remain in validation
